name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed due to insufficient energy extraction (low vavg and slow startup for S4, S5, S6) and lack of voltage regulation (vmax too high for S3). I'm implementing a Parallel-SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) circuit to significantly increase the energy extracted from the piezo. This is achieved by using an inductor and a switch to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance at its extrema. To prevent vout from exceeding 3.6V, I've added a DZ33 Zener diode as a clamp on the output node. A larger output capacitor (4.7uF) is used to minimize ripple and ensure stability.
